summary: The Tailwind brand palette is correctly defined and current UI surfaces use brand tokens, but AC-2 is not fully satisfied because hex color literals were moved into lib/brand.ts rather than kept exclusively in tailwind.config.ts.

findings.title: Hex literals remain outside Tailwind config
findings.details: AC-2 explicitly requires no inline hex outside config. brandColors duplicates #C8A165, #3E2723, #F5E6D3, #8D6E63, and #A1887F in lib/brand.ts. This also contradicts the module's single-source-of-truth claim because tailwind.config.ts remains a second independent source. Keep the literal palette only in tailwind.config.ts and derive any non-class consumer from that configuration, or defer/remove the themeColor value until it can consume a config-derived token without duplicating literals.

verified: tailwind.config.ts defines brand.light, brand.dark, and brand.cream with the required values.
app/layout.tsx, app/page.tsx, and app/globals.css use Tailwind brand tokens or Tailwind theme() references for visible backgrounds and text.
The inspected diff changes viewport.themeColor to brandColors.dark and adds lib/brand.ts containing duplicated hex literals.
verification_gaps: Build and lint were not re-run within this review budget; one npm probe was aborted and repository-wide rg probes timed out.

goal_tracker_alignment.details: The tracker still lists AC-2 as pending and only AC-1 as completed, which is appropriate given this blocking issue. No goal drift or unjustified tracker update request was found.
